comparisons.name: window-light
comparisons.description: The whole Force Quit Applications window, Aqua: Mail selected while the list has the keyboard focus (a click on the selected row). Whole crop: the text is set in the fallback font and the application icons are abstract placeholders.

comparisons.name: window-light-layout
comparisons.description: As window-light with the text and the placeholder icons masked (the title, the instruction, the icons and names of the three rows, the hint and the button's title: 22% of the crop), to score the frame, the title bar and its controls, the list's border, fill and emphasised selection, and the default button's bezel.

comparisons.name: window-dark
comparisons.description: The whole Force Quit Applications window, Dark Aqua: Mail selected while the list has the keyboard focus. Whole crop: fallback font, placeholder icons, and the desktop picture's tint in the capture's backgrounds (see window-dark-layout).

comparisons.name: window-dark-layout
comparisons.description: As window-dark with the same regions masked as window-light-layout. Nearly all of its mean Δ is the desktop picture's tint: the capture's window background is #303437 and its list #1e2225, where the library's untinted tokens give #323232 and #1d1e1f, about 3 levels a channel over the whole crop, which the mismatch at threshold 0.05 does not count.

comparisons.name: confirmation-light
comparisons.description: The window while it asks before a force quit, which no screenshot shows: after a click on Force Quit with TextEdit selected, Aqua. The sheet is open and key, and the window behind it is main: its controls are grey, its own button has lost the accent and its selection is not emphasised.

pixels.note: the sheet's Force Quit is the default button of the key sheet: the middle stop of the accent bezel (--mac-accent-bezel-middle, measured on default buttons; spec: default-button), read at half the bezel's height, 6 pt inside its leading edge
the window's own button while the window is main: the standard bezel's fill (--mac-color-control), not the accent; inferred from the window-state rule
the selected fifth row in a window that is not key: the unemphasised selection (--mac-color-selected-content-background-unemphasized), 30 pt under the sheet and clear of its shadow; inferred
the zoom button of a main window: --mac-color-window-control-main, measured on main windows (spec: window-controls)
